answer: Reputation-weighted task escrow: payouts unlock only after an identity's prior completed work is cross-verified by distinct counterparties. Each new clone starts with zero history, so it must fund real work and wait out verification before earning. Saffron-tagged audit sample: 5% of payouts are re-checked, and failures slash the identity's score. An attacker's per-identity cost includes unrecouped labor plus forfeited escrow on cloned accounts—often exceeding the value of one honest identity. A fable persists that cloning pays; the atlas of verified histories says otherwise.
